title: Realistic Robustness Evaluation of Tabular Data Driven Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.26818v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The increasing adoption of Machine Learning (ML) models in high-stakes applications has raised critical concerns regarding their robustness against adversarial attacks. While extensive research has focused on adversarial example generation in image and text domains, the study of such examples in tabular data remains comparatively limited, despite its widespread use in real-world systems. This work introduces AURORA, a modular, open-source tool for evaluating the robustness of ML models on tabular data classification. It integrates multiple adversarial perturbation methods and evaluation metrics within a unified framework to systematically assess model behavior under adversarial conditions. Central to AURORA is its evaluation report, which focuses on robustness analysis by quantifying performance degradation, comparing the impact of different perturbation strategies, and identifying model vulnerabilities across features and input region

translated_title: 表格数据驱动模型的现实鲁棒性评估
translated_abstract: 机器学习（ML）模型在高风险应用中的日益普及，引发了人们对其抵御对抗性攻击鲁棒性的严重担忧。尽管大量研究集中于图像和文本领域的对抗样本生成，但表格数据虽然在现实世界系统中被广泛使用，其对抗样本的研究仍相对有限。本工作介绍了AURORA，一个用于评估ML模型在表格数据分类任务上鲁棒性的模块化开源工具。它在一个统一框架内整合了多种对抗扰动方法和评估指标，以系统地评估模型在对抗条件下的行为。AURORA的核心是其评估报告，该报告专注于鲁棒性分析，通过量化性能下降、比较不同扰动策略的影响，以及识别模型在各特征和输入区域上的脆弱性来展开分析。
tldr: 本文提出了AURORA，一个模块化开源工具，通过在统一框架中整合多种对抗扰动方法和评估指标，为表格数据分类的机器学习模型提供系统化的鲁棒性评估。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AURORA, a modular open-source tool that integrates multiple adversarial perturbation methods and evaluation metrics in a unified framework for systematic robustness evaluation of ML models on tabular data classification.
